---
title: "Daylight"
---

```{r}
source("R/weather.R")
source("R/dashboard.R")
snapshot <- read_dashboard_snapshot()
daily <- dashboard_daily(snapshot)
daily$daylight_hours <- as.numeric(difftime(daily$sunset, daily$sunrise, units = "hours"))
```

`r dashboard_freshness(snapshot)`

Scroll the chart horizontally on smaller screens.

## Light for the week ahead

::: {.chart-scroll tabindex="0" role="region" aria-label="Scrollable forecast chart"}
```{r}
#| results: asis
#| fig-alt: "Hours between sunrise and sunset for the upcoming Copenhagen forecast dates."
library(ggplot2)
if (!nrow(daily)) {
  cat("No daylight forecast is available from today.\n")
} else {
  print(ggplot(daily, aes(date, daylight_hours)) + geom_col(fill = "#fbbf24") +
    scale_x_date(date_labels = "%a\n%d %b", date_breaks = "1 day") +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Daylight hours") + dashboard_chart_theme())
}
```
:::

Sunrise and sunset use Copenhagen local time. The outlook starts on `r format(dashboard_now(snapshot), "%Y-%m-%d", tz = snapshot$timezone)`.
